instructions: Answer any three out of the remaining five questions.
Assume any suitable data wherever required and justify the same.

questions.label: 1a
questions.text: Explain how big data problems are handled by Hadoop system.

questions.label: 1b
questions.text: Mention four characteristics of big data and explain in detail.

questions.label: 1c
questions.text: List and explain the core business drivers behind the NoSQL movement.

questions.label: 1d
questions.text: Explain the concept of bloom filter with an example.

questions.label: 2a
questions.text: What is graph store? Give an example where a graph store can be used to effectively solve a particular business problem.

questions.label: 2b
questions.text: Write a map reduce pseudo code for word count problem. Illustrate with an example showing all the steps.

questions.label: 3a
questions.text: Suppose the stream is S = \{4, 2, 5, 9, 1, 6, 3, 7\}. Let hash functions h(x) = 3x + 7 mod 32 for some a and b, treat result as a 5-bit binary integer. Show how the Flajolet-Martin algorithm will estimate the number of distinct elements in this stream.

questions.label: 4a
questions.text: Explain selection and projection relational algebraic operation using MapReduce.

questions.label: 4b
questions.text: Explain DGIM algorithm for counting ones in a stream with example.

questions.label: 5a
questions.text: Determine communities for the given social network graph using Girvan-Newman algorithm.
questions.note: Graph in the paper, edges: A-B, B-C, A-D, B-E, C-F, D-E, E-F.

questions.label: 5b
questions.text:
Consider the following data frame given below:

| course | id | class | marks |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 11 | 1 | 56 |
| 2 | 12 | 2 | 75 |
| 3 | 13 | 1 | 48 |
| 4 | 14 | 2 | 69 |
| 5 | 15 | 1 | 84 |
| 6 | 16 | 2 | 53 |

i. Create a subset of course less than 5 by using [ ] brackets and demonstrate the output.

ii. Create a subset where the course column is less than 4 or the class equals to 1 by using subset () function and demonstrate the output.

questions.label: 6a
questions.text:
i. Write a script to create a dataset named data1 in R containing the following text.

Text: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.7, 7, 8.1, 9

ii. Explain the various functions provided by R to combine different sets of data.

questions.label: 6b
questions.text: Describe collaborative filtering in recommendation system.
